jcr:content.jcr:title: Arctic Surfing, Norway

hero-mount.headline: Arctic Surfing,
hero-mount.subheadline: Paddle out beneath the Northern Lights and chase glassy A-frames on deserted Arctic beaches.

text_intro.text:
Surf the edge of the world

Above the Arctic Circle, the Norwegian sea throws clean, cold-water peaks onto empty white-sand beaches framed by jagged 1,000-metre peaks. This is surfing as pilgrimage — a week of dawn patrols, neoprene, and mirror-still fjords under endless polar light.

image_primary.alt: Cold-water surfer paddling out into an Arctic lineup at sunrise

text_body.text:
What to expect

  • Unstad and Flakstad point breaks, with uncrowded line-ups even at peak swell.
  • 6/5mm hooded wetsuits, boots and gloves provided — water temps 4–7°C.
  • Cabin lodging overlooking the beach, family-style Nordic dinners each evening.
  • Daily aurora forecasting — clear-sky nights almost always deliver.

Who it's for

Confident intermediate surfers and above. You should be able to paddle out unaided and catch an overhead shoulder. We'll handle the cold; you bring the stoke.
